race.comment: ROCKET SCIENCE (7) shapes well for this backing up a swift 22.21 win with success at Ballarat over 390m last time, recording 22.03. Rates a top chance again if runs up to recent form. NOT PERFECT (8) is better than last start when fourth (19.84) from Box 7 at this track over 350m. The form from his last run stacks up well. Leading chance. OHTANI FORCE (5) goes very well over this trip including three wins. In the money last time at Ballarat (22.21) in a Grade 5, finishing a 3.5 lengths third. Among the main chances. ROARING ENGINE (6) has strong credentials over this journey.
